svg.title: Design System
svg.text: Tokens and components from docs/UI_UX_GUIDELINES.md · mirrors src/theme
Amazigh flag palette. Contrast ratios are text on background #FAF7F2 (AA needs 4.5:1 for body text).
Poppins for Latin script · Noto Sans Tifinagh for Tifinagh (always visible).
Short, interactive lessons with instant feedback.

svg.text: 4-pt scale. Touch targets are at least 44×44 pt.
Answer states: default, selected, correct (green), incorrect (red).
Skeletons instead of spinners · empty states with an illustration and a call to action.
24-pt outline icons (2 pt stroke) · diamond band inspired by Amazigh rugs, used sparingly.
